==Biography==

Liu "'''Kitties'''" Hong-Jun played for [[All Gamers]] and [[RisingStars Gaming]] in Season 2 and 3 under the name "'''Cocoa'''". He joined [[Invictus Gaming]] in the 2014 Season as a replacement for [[XiaoXiao]].

===2014 Season===

Kitties played his first real tournament with IG at [[Demacia Cup/Season 1|Demacia Cup Season 1]]. They made it to the finals and placed first after beating WE 3-2. A few months later, they attended the [[IEM Season VIII - World Championship]] but failed to make it past groups after losing to the [[KT Rolster Bullets]] and [[Fnatic]]. The [[2014 LPL Spring/Regular Season|2014 LPL Spring Regular Season]] ended shortly afterwards with IG in fourth place. IG qualified for the [[2014 LPL Spring/Playoffs|2014 LPL Spring Playoffs]] and even made it to the finals but they lost 3-0 to [[EDward Gaming]]. They later lost 2-0 in [[Demacia Cup/Season 2|Demacia Cup Season 2]] in the round of 16 to [[Star Horn Royal Club]]. IG faired very poorly in the [[2014 LPL Summer/Regular Season|2014 LPL Summer Regular Season]], finishing in sixth place. They still qualified for the [[2014 Season China Regional Finals]] but they finished in last after losing 2-0 to [[OMG]] and 2-1 to [[LGD Gaming]].

===2015 Season===

IG played in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Spring Season|2015 Demacia Cup Spring Season]] where they managed to make it to the finals but they lost 3-0 to EDG. A few weeks later, they finished in fifth place in the [[2015 LPL/Spring/Regular Season|2015 LPL Spring Regular Season]] and qualified for the [[2015 LPL/Spring/Playoffs|2015 LPL Spring Playoffs]]. Here, IG ended in third place after losing 3-0 to EDG in the semifinals but beating [[Snake eSports]] 3-1 in the third place match. IG participated in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Summer Season|2015 Demacia Cup Summer Season]] and ended in fourth after losing 3-1 to EDG and 3-2 to Snake. Back in the [[2015 LPL/Summer/Regular Season|2015 LPL Summer Regular Season]], IG ended in third place to qualify for the [[2015 LPL/Summer/Playoffs|2015 LPL Summer Playoffs]]. Here, IG finished in third place again after losing 3-2 to the [[Qiao Gu Reapers]] but beating EDG 3-1. IG qualified for the [[2015 Season China Regional Finals]] and managed to qualify for the [[2015 Season World Championship]] by beating Qiao Gu 3-0. IG was placed in a group alongside [[Cloud9]], Fnatic, and [[AHQ e-Sports Club]]. Unfortunately, they ended with a 2-4 record and were knocked out of the tournament in last place.

===2016 Season===

The 2016 season was fairly straightforward for IG. The team placed 4th in the [[LPL/2016_Season/Spring_Season|2016 LPL Spring Season]] with an 8-8 record. They were quickly knocked out of playoffs in the first round after getting swept 0-3 by Snake Esports. The [[LPL/2016_Season/Summer_Season|summer season]] was identical to the spring one for IG since they finished in 4th again with a 5-11 record. The [[LPL/2016_Season/Summer_Playoffs|summer playoffs]] also had the same result and IG were knocked out in the first round again by getting swept by [[I May]]. Kitties left Invictus Gaming in December of 2016.

===2017 Season===

In April of 2017 Kitties briefly joined [[Young Glory]]. The team finished 2nd at [[Tencent_Games_Arena_Hero_of_Cities/Season_12|TGA Hero of Cities Season 12]] after an 0-2 loss to [[EDG.Revengers]] in the finals. In May Kitties retired from professional play.
